name: Jehoiachin
summary: A son of Jehoiakim who reigned over Judah for only three months before he was carried away captive to Babylon. After many years in prison there, a new king of Babylon set him free and gave him a place at his table.

key_moments.title: Carried Away to Babylon
key_moments.description: When the army of Nebuchadnezzar besieged Jerusalem, Jehoiachin gave himself up to the king of Babylon with his mother, servants and princes. He was taken to Babylon, along with the LORD's temple treasures and thousands of captives.

key_moments.title: Brought Out of Prison
key_moments.description: In the thirty-seventh year of his captivity, Evilmerodach king of Babylon brought Jehoiachin out of prison. He spoke kindly to him, gave him a seat higher than the other kings there, and fed him at his table for the rest of his life.

key_moments.title: A Signet Pulled Off
key_moments.description: The LORD said that even if Coniah were the signet ring on His right hand, He would pull him off. He would give him to Nebuchadrezzar and cast him out into a land he did not know.
